item.description: The fire under Demope Eurmenides ~1224 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.

item.title: Arilaos #7669 the Twice-Born re-knit and came home, and did not know their own child, Krat
item.description: Arilaos #7669 the Twice-Born re-knit and came home, and did not know their own child, Kratides Antimnikides ~501. The Leaf stood at the door and was asked its name.

item.description: A child for the House of Echion: Sparto Eurmenides ~1388, born to Eurmenes #5770 and Dorides #6253. It will grow old; its parents will not.
